title: feat(automation): the stage confirms name the flows a move would start (#35928)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTRdLmK9YYgMSCJ7NH2PuUY)_

repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oLLK7uoxp33riiBJL

Fixes #35928

Clause-②: yes (widening: one new public read, `POST /api/v1/automation/_record-starts`, and the UI exports that read it)
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 7073655354

## 维护者速读

- 列表单元格和记录页的阶段确认框，现在会在原句下列出这次改动会启动的流程名称（按读者语言翻译），带审批的流程标「发起审批」。
- 服务端新增一个只读接口 `POST /api/v1/automation/_record-starts`：能读这条记录的人就能问；读不到记录的人得到与记录不存在相同的 404。
- 只列启用且启动条件成立的流程；不列钩子、不给条件和节点；条件复用引擎唯一的启动判断，触发器词法挪进 spec 共用。
- 读失败或一个都没有时，确认框和今天完全一样。

## What changes

**Server (one new read).**

- `@objectstack/spec/api`: `RecordUpdateStartsRequestSchema` (`{ object, recordId, changes }`, strict), `RecordUpdateStartSchema` (`{ name, label, startsApproval }`), `RecordUpdateStartsResponseSchema`, and the contract entry `listRecordUpdateStarts` (`POST /api/v1/automation/_record-starts`). `_record-starts` joins the `/automation` domain's reserved position literals (underscore-led, so the package-namespace install gate is not narrowed).
- `@objectstack/spec/contracts`: `RecordUpdateStartsInput` and the optional `IAutomationService.listRecordUpdateStarts`.
- `@objectstack/spec/automation`: `recordChangeTriggerHookEvents` / `recordChangeTriggerFiresOnUpdate`, the record-change token grammar MOVED out of `@objectstack/trigger-record-change` (whose `triggerTypeToHookEvents` now delegates to it), so the trigger and the preview read one rule.
- `@objectstack/service-automation`: `AutomationEngine.listRecordUpdateStarts` (`record-update-starts.ts`). A flow is asked only when it is enabled and armed on a `record_change` trigger for this object whose token binds an update; whether it starts is `startConditionHolds`, the one start-condition gate every run attempt passes, over the variables `seedRunVariables` seeds (`record`, its flattened fields, `previous`). The approval mark is the presence of an `APPROVAL_NODE_TYPE` node (ADR-0019). A condition that throws is not listed. Hooks are never listed (ADR-0077 §2).
- `@objectstack/runtime`: the `/automation` domain's `_record-starts` door, mounted in the dispatcher plugin and recorded in the route ledger. Order: query parameters refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`; body parsed through the request schema (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED`); `501` when the engine has no preview; the record read AS THE CALLER through the `/data` door's own `get` (`callData`), so an unreadable record answers `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` exactly like an absent one and the engine is never asked; then the engine is handed `previous` = the record read, `record` = that record with `changes` applied, and the caller's `userId` / `tenantId`. Anonymous `401`.
- `@objectstack/client`: `client.automation.listRecordUpdateStarts(request)`.

**UI (two confirms, one reader).**

- `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: `stageChangeStarts.tsx` — `useRecordUpdateStarts(ask)` (asks the route once per pending move through the host's `apiFetch`, parses the answer through `RecordUpdateStartsResponseSchema`, answers `[]` while in flight, refused, failing, malformed or empty) and `StageChangeStarts` (the list under the sentence: each flow by its label translated through `activeFlowsBundle` + the spec's `translateFlow`, the flow runner's reading; an approval flow marked). Exported for the grid.
- Record page: `recordPathStageChange.tsx` draws it in both confirmations (the path's `AlertDialog` and the header stage menu's `RequiredFieldsDialog`, via a new optional `notice` slot in `@object-ui/fields`).
- List cell: `ObjectGrid`'s state-machine confirm draws it; `StateChangeConfirm` gains an optional `ask` (the row's record id and the move).
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `activeFlowsBundle` moves here from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s module-internal `utils/flowsBundle` (its three app-shell importers repointed), since the confirms' packages do not depend on the console; two keys in all eleven packs: `detail.stageChangeStartsHeading`, `detail.stageChangeStartsApproval`.
- The confirm's sentence is never replaced (not this card: #35685 S3). A move that starts nothing, and a failed read, leave the confirm exactly as today.

Docs: `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (§ Which flows a record update would start), `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` (the confirm now names the flows). Changesets: `35928-record-update-starts-read.md`, `35928-stage-confirm-names-flows.md`, both carrying the Clause-② and Metadata-protocol lines.

## Tests

- Engine `record-update-starts.test.ts` (8): condition holds / does not hold; approval mark CONTROL (an approval flow and a plain flow side by side); no condition; create / delete / other object / obsolete never named while `record-before-write` is; an unevaluable condition not named; an unarmed engine answers nothing; `current_user` evaluated as the writer named.
- Door `automation-record-update-starts.test.ts` (9): a member is answered (body parsed through the response schema) and the engine is handed exactly the record read as the caller; empty list; unreadable record `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` with the engine never asked; unreadable and absent answer alike; anonymous `401` before any read; malformed body `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`; query parameter `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`; `501` without the preview; a GET of the literal is not this door.
- Spec `automation-api.zod.test.ts`: contract count and the new entry's method/path; request strictness; a leaked `condition` / `nodes` dropped by the response parse.
- List cell, in its confirm's harness `ObjectGrid.autosave-35685.test.tsx` (new top-level describe, 3): list (request body pinned, labels, approval mark under the unchanged sentence), empty, failure (and Change still saves the move).
- Record page, in each confirm's harness (new top-level describe in each, 3 + 3): `record-path.stageChange-28199.test.tsx` (the path's confirmation) and `RecordStageMenu-35891.test.tsx` (the header stage menu's dialog): list, empty, failure (a refused read, a network error and a malformed envelope each draw no list).
- `stageChangeStarts-label-35928.test.tsx` (2): a flow named by its translation where the app's `flows` bundle has one, by its authored label where not; nothing drawn for no flows.
- Ablation (one-shot under the verify lock, restored by trap, `git diff HEAD` on both sources empty): removing the `<StageChangeStarts>` render from `ObjectGrid.tsx` and from both confirmations in `recordPathStageChange.tsx` turns exactly the three `list:` pins red (`Tests 3 failed | 6 passed`); empty and failure pins stay green, as they should.

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance: "Changing a stage that starts a flow shows that flow by name in both confirms" — pinned in both confirms (list cell, and both record-page confirmations) and measured live (below); "a stage with nothing attached shows no list" — the empty pins; "a read failure falls back to the generic sentence" — the failure pins.
- Residual (not widened here): conditions are judged on the record as the CALLER reads it (field-level security applied), so a condition that reads a field the caller cannot see is judged on what they see, and one that throws on a missing field is not listed. The preview can therefore under-list for a caller with masked fields; it never reveals a masked value. Documented in `flows.mdx`.
- Residual: the header stage menu's dialog asks with the stage alone; values typed into that dialog for required fields are not part of the preview's `changes`.
- Two existing confirm suites (`RecordStageMenu-35891`, `record-path.stageChange-28199`) now stub `fetch` with a `501` answer in `beforeEach`, so the new read does not leave for the network under test; no existing assertion changed. Across the touched UI packages the run shows 0 `ECONNREFUSED`.
- Open question (not widened here): the approval mark is the ruling's test, "the flow contains an approval node". Measured live, showcase's `showcase_project_closure` reaches its sign-off approval through a `subflow` node (the approval node lives in `showcase_closure_signoff`), so the preview lists it with `startsApproval: false`. Following subflow references for the mark would be a reading beyond the ruling; left for the area / L2 to decide.
- Overlap (`overlap-check.mjs`, exit 1, reported and not merged around): #36296 (#36036, same area) conflicts in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx` (both edit `useStageChange`'s dialog), and #36236 conflicts in the generated `content/docs/references/index.mdx` (regenerated by `gen:docs` on whichever lands second). Everything else merges cleanly with `origin/main` and the other open PRs.

## Verification

- Read first: `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` `respondToRecordUpdateStarts` (the order of refusals and the caller-scoped read that admits the engine), then `packages/services/service-automation/src/record-update-starts.ts` (which flows are asked and the one gate they pass).
- Live, on a fresh showcase (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`), as a member created by the admin (`role: user`, not an admin):
  - `Website Relaunch` `status: active → completed`: `200 {"flows":[{"name":"showcase_project_closure","label":"Project Closure with Sign-off (nested pause)","startsApproval":false}]}`
  - same record `→ on_hold` (CONTROL): `200 {"flows":[]}`
  - same record `budget 150000 → 250000`: `200 {"flows":[{"name":"showcase_budget_approval","label":"Project Budget Approval","startsApproval":true}]}`
  - an absent record: `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`; anonymous: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`; a body without `changes`: `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` naming `changes`.
  - Zone 2 premise, measured before any code: the same kind of member reads `GET /api/v1/meta/flow` (200, 33 flows with labels, the admin's set) and `GET /api/v1/meta/flow/showcase_closure_signoff` (200, its nodes).
  - The console itself was not driven in a browser (its dist is not built in this container); both confirms are pinned through the real components above.
- Local, all under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (shared box):
  - touched UI packages (`plugin-detail`, `plugin-grid`, `fields`, `i18n`): `Test Files 1131 passed | 2 skipped` · `Tests 13186 passed | 38 skipped`; after folding the pins into their harness files the three files plus the label file: `Tests 77 passed (77)`.
  - type-check: `tsc --noEmit` (src and test projects) for `i18n`, `fields`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-grid`, and src for `app-shell`; `service-automation`, `runtime`, `client` exit 0.
  - server: engine 8/8, door 9/9, `route-ledger.conformance` + `automation-api-contract-mounts` + `http-dispatcher` green, client conformance 11, spec `automation-api.zod` + `address-grammar` 87, `trigger-record-change` 122.
  - `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (129 families) run and reconciled with `--ran`: `129 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. First pass reds were all this diff's own owed artefacts, fixed and re-run green: spec `gen:api-surface` / `gen:docs` / `gen:export-origins` / `gen:declaration-map` / `gen:strictness-ledger` (api count 533 → 536: the three new schemas), the route-ledger census sentence (149 → 150), and `check:test-source-alias` (a spec/automation alias in the trigger package's vitest config; the door test pays `@objectstack/metadata` at collection).
